verdictBasis: 0 blockers, 3 SHOULD-FIX, 2 advisories. The dispatch gate was 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX.
verdictStatement: v5 changes nothing but the honesty ledger, and I confirmed that: every substantive path is byte-identical to v4, so the verbatim layer, graphRules, the three cores, the default install, the platform set and both named reservations all still stand, and none of the dispatch's other attacks lands. The structural half of my v4 finding is repaired — ADV-1, ADV-4 and ADV-5 are out of notFoldedThisSuccessor and into honestyRepairsFromV3, with ADV-2 marked partial. But the entries written to accomplish that state three things that are false against v5's own bytes. The CLAUDE-V3-ADV-4 entry says the v1 verdict pin is restored at appliesFindingsOf.claude2v1HistoricalPin; v5 deleted that key in the same edit. The CLAUDE-V3-ADV-2 entry says the duplicate terminal SATISFIED line was removed at v4; it sits at indices 12 and 19 of a reviewGuidance array that is byte-identical to v4's, and the notFolded entry meanwhile names as the outstanding half the line that actually was folded, describing its own HISTORICAL label while calling it unfolded. Separately and worse, claude2v4 records my v4 verdict as carrying zero advisories when it carried three, and none of the three appears anywhere else in the ledger — while codexv4's two advisories from the same round are both recorded and declared. Three live findings leave the lineage without a word. This is the same defect class my v4 S-1 named, reproduced inside the repair for it, and in a version whose only purpose was to make the ledger accurate. Two of the four new entries are sound; the fix for the rest is a swap, a restored key and a corrected count.

coordinatorNote: REJECT of the artifact, not a disposition of the row. DR-101 stays OPEN at file 08 line 283. The contract itself remains clean and untouched — I verified byte-identity against v4 across every substantive path, so nothing from v1 through v4's repairs has regressed and the design content is not in question. All three findings sit in /appliesFindingsOf and /honestyRepairsFromV3, and every fix is a text edit: correct claude2v4's advisory list to the three CLAUDE-V4-ADV ids, restore or re-describe the claude2v1HistoricalPin reference, and swap the two halves of the ADV-2 record (or delete reviewGuidance index 19 and call ADV-2 fully folded). Three observations for pacing. First, this is the second consecutive round where the honesty ledger, not the contract, is the only thing failing — the design work converged at v4 and the bookkeeping has not. It may be worth the coordinator specifying the ledger's required shape once, rather than another round of reviewers finding entries individually. Second, Codex ACCEPTed v4 while I rejected it, so the lanes have diverged; v5 folded only my finding, and DCIC-V4-A1/A2 remain openly undeclared-as-folded. Third, I could not verify v5's record of the Codex v4 verdict because I did not open that file — given that my central finding is a misrecorded verdict, the coordinator should not assume the codexv4 record is accurate merely because the claude2v4 one was checked and found wrong.
